QF.id: I Codes of Conduct and Investor Protection_3

question.text: KYC (Know Your Client) norms require brokers to:

answer.text: Verify the identity, address, financial status, occupation, and other prescribed personal information of clients before opening accounts
Only collect the client's name and phone number
Only verify if the client has a bank account
Only check if the client has previous trading experience

explanation.text: The Logic: KYC requires verification of identity and address, financial status, occupation, and other prescribed personal information before an account is opened. The Trap: KYC is comprehensive — not limited to basic name/phone, bank-account confirmation, or trading-experience checks. Note: KYC information must be collected before account opening; once recorded with a KYC Registration Agency (KRA), it can be relied on across SEBI-registered intermediaries.
